rpx_setup_army_state = {
	rpx_calc_army_baseline = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_army_state }
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_army_state }
	}
}
